title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Crocoblock…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Crocoblock JetTabs (jet-tabs) versions up to 2.3.5. This vulnerability involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation, which could allow an attacker with low privileges to execute malicious scripts in the context of the affected application. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6.5.
